description: This file contains implementation of functions related to the Persistent Storage Manager's System Registry object, including getters, setters, and reset functions for various properties and interfaces within the system registry component.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PsmSysroGetPsmSseIf(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the PSM SSE Interface object associated with the system registry object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroSetPsmSseIf(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hInterface)
methods.description: Sets or updates the PSM SSE Interface object associated with the system registry object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PsmSysroGetPsmFileLoader(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the PSM file loader object associated with the system registry object.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE PsmSysroGetSysInfoRepository(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Retrieves the system info repository object associated with the system registry.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroGetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hProperty)
methods.description: Copies the current system registry properties into the provided property structure.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroSetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hProperty)
methods.description: Updates the system registry properties with the provided property structure and ensures default filenames if not set.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroResetProperty(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets the system registry properties to default values.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS PsmSysroReset(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Resets the state of the system registry object (currently a no-op).
